description: This bar chart compares the performance of two models, TA-SQL and DIN-SQL, across three evaluation metrics—Recall, Precision, and F1 Score—under two different training conditions: zero-shot and few-shot. The horizontal axis displays the three metrics, while the vertical axis represents the performance score on a linear scale ranging from 40 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 20. Each metric has three bars corresponding to the two models and their respective training conditions, as indicated by the legend: a light blue bar for TA-SQL (zero-shot), a dark blue bar for TA-SQL (few-shot), a light green bar for DIN-SQL (zero-shot), and a dark green bar for DIN-SQL (few-shot). For Recall, the values are 63.58 for TA-SQL (zero-shot), 71.90 for TA-SQL (few-shot), and 72.29 for DIN-SQL (zero-shot). For Precision, the values are 88.89 for TA-SQL (zero-shot), 91.24 for TA-SQL (few-shot), and 92.31 for DIN-SQL (zero-shot). For F1 Score, the values are 75.34 for TA-SQL (zero-shot), 80.40 for TA-SQL (few-shot), and 81.08 for DIN-SQL (zero-shot). The bars are grouped by metric, with each group containing one bar for each model under each condition. The bars are not sorted by height; they are presented in the order of the metrics on the horizontal axis. All bars are solid-colored without any shading or emphasis.
